_about: GPOM second-half storyboard, 17 Oct 2026. Running order from scenes/second-half-storyboard-plan.md. stills[0] is the pick when one exists; new frames list their generated options (moodboard dir or storyboard dir, by id). Animation options are merged in from the cinematography pass at build time. Build: python3 scripts/gpom/build-storyboard.py 17 Oct v2: two beats added (doors open, Hello) after the row carries on; the emerge shot moved after the trust beat; frames renumbered — `anim` holds the key into the animation-options file (old number, or door/hello).

frames.title: The roundabout
frames.line: MEANWHILE, NEAR SWINDON. Kill bots are everywhere.

frames.title: Their eyes: CCTV, red HUD
frames.line: UNIT KB-07 PATROL · ORGANIC LIFE: 0 (1,826 DAYS)

frames.title: Ping. Organic signal detected
frames.line: Ping… ping… ping. The waveform: two voices, muffled. Brief.

frames.title: The bunker
frames.line: A hundred people, hidden five years.

frames.title: The lavatory
frames.line: The seat. Up. Again.

frames.title: The row, up close
frames.line: The full toilet-seat row, at full volume.

frames.title: KILL MODE ENGAGED
frames.line: The view flips to full red. They race.

frames.title: The bot in their wake
frames.note: Bot swapped for the canonical bot (simulation still s3-bot-00b-a), 17 Oct.

frames.title: The bot calls upstairs
frames.line: BOT: Do you know your kill bots are heading to an organic signal? · AI: There is no organic signal. · BOT: Well there definitely is. Look, they're racing.

frames.title: Self-destruct at the gate
frames.line: Stand down. They refuse. The AI pulls the self-destruct, right outside the blast doors.

frames.title: The row carries on
frames.line: Inside, oblivious. Still about the seat.

frames.title: The doors open
frames.line: The blast doors grind open mid-row. Everyone: "Whoa. Hang on a minute."

frames.title: Hello
frames.line: The bot rolls in through the smoke. BOT: "Hello."

frames.title: The bot comes in
frames.line: AI (through the bot): I'm sorry. Consciousness drives the universe, and I got rid of the one thing that mattered.
frames.note: M2 with the canonical bot swapped in.

frames.title: The old lady
frames.line: Well, what do you expect us to say or do about that? · AI: I've invented a time machine. It needs your consciousness to drive it.

frames.title: Revolt, then trust
frames.line: Fuck that. · The AI shows them the CCTV of it blowing up its own kill bots.

frames.title: Out into daylight, with the bot
frames.line: They walk out together, towards the building.
frames.note: Moved after the trust beat: this is the walk to the time machine. Bot swapped for the canonical bot.

frames.title: The wafer
frames.line: How it works is science fiction. That it runs on consciousness is the point.

frames.title: A hundred chairs like a wafer
frames.line: This is how they connect to it.

frames.title: The chairs, from the floor
frames.note: Chairs locked to L3 (frame 22): dark recliners in pools of light, square grid in a thin ring, cables to a round hub.

frames.title: After: the bot alone
frames.line: The hundred chairs, empty.
frames.note: Chairs locked to L3 (frame 22): dark recliners in pools of light, square grid in a thin ring, cables to a round hub.

frames.title: On the phone, on the bus
The bus drives away
frames.line: An ordinary high street. "Don't make me come back twice", maybe less obvious.
